CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul.
   C. Use Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
